scenes.headline: How a 360 walk becomes a splat scene
scenes.sub: Capture, poses, scale, training and rendering, as practitioners do it
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bun! Here is how one walk with a 360 camera becomes a Gaussian splat scene.

scenes.text: Solve every pose on the whole panorama as one camera, train on cube faces, and pin real scale with a printed tag or the phone's location.
scenes.say: Solve every pose on the whole panorama, as one camera. Then train on cube faces, and pin real scale early.

items.text: Fly or walk with a 360 camera
items.say: Walk or fly once, filming every direction.

items.text: Keep sharp frames, mask the operator
items.say: Keep sharp frames. Mask the operator and the seam.
Solve each panorama as one spherical camera.
Cut it into six square faces.
Train millions of Gaussians on them.

left.title: Two fisheye streams
items: The solver must discover the rig
left.say: Two fisheye streams barely overlap, so the solver must discover the rig. Long walks break apart.

right.title: One panorama per instant
items: Every frame connected on a 2 km walk
right.say: One panorama is one camera. On a two kilometre walk, every frame connected.

steps.say: Images alone have no scale. A printed tag of known size gives metres.
Or the phone's location joins bundle adjustment as a weak prior.
Vision keeps the shape. Location sets scale and stops drift.
Then the splat lands on a map, at the right size.

scenes.title: Rendering without a sort
scenes.say: Normal blending sorts every splat, every frame. This is the weight each one needs.

parts.note: chance this splat survives the dither
parts.say: Draw splats opaque, keeping each with a chance equal to its opacity.

parts.note: every splat in front must drop out
parts.say: It shows only if everything in front dropped out. The depth buffer orders it for free.

scenes.title: One phone frame
scenes.say: On a Pixel 7 Pro, a whole stochastic frame takes seven and a half milliseconds. In the sorted path, the sort alone takes nineteen and a half.

scenes.credit: @slimbuck7 on X, frames from the post's video
scenes.title: One frame, then many

steps.say: One frame is a scatter of opaque flecks.
Averaged over frames, it resolves to the smooth image.

scenes.text: Treat the panorama as one camera, pin scale early, and let the depth buffer do the sorting.
scenes.say: One camera per panorama, scale early, and let depth do the sorting.

recap: Poses on the panorama, training on cube faces
Scale from a tag or the phone's location
Stochastic splats skip the per-frame sort
scenes.say: Poses on the panorama, scale from a tag or phone, and no sort.
